runs.qualification: Normal source without trial flags passes production-shader/fade ownership checks, 194.253 m physical walking/turning, 1024 forest cells, live actors and unchanged save/runtime hashes. All 48 captures are consecutive and pixel-hash verified; measured cadence 16 ms median / 32 ms p95. No overlapping engine job observed. Timing phases exclude capture; this individual run is not a matched GPU baseline comparison. Full context and sampled motion frames inspected; human visual approval remains open.

Earlier source-capped cost-only comparison: quiet accepted groups 0/2/3, rejected overlapping group 1. Median deltas -0.298/-1.346/-0.783 ms; tail deltas +1.152/-0.940/+1.128 ms. Substantial GPU clock downshifting makes this unsuitable as a fixed-cost win. Superseded for cost qualification by uncapped paired runs; failure/uncertainty preserved.

Rejected framing: ground view yielded 48 stone samples but only seven pale-flower samples across four plants. No causal replay ran. Production/save/population checks passed. Kept minimum twelve-anchor gate and moved the next diagnostic view 8m above normal eye; normal gameplay remains a separate grounded gate.
Rejected elevated framing: six flower samples across three plants, below unchanged twelve/four gate. No causal replay accepted.

Stone causal controls passed, 48 anchors across 18 actual stones at 60–120m. Fixed-low equals automatic. Normal-map, flat-texture, fade and specular controls do not materially remove moving residual; unlit still unstable. Supports subpixel silhouette coverage as dominant tested cause.

Flower causal controls passed after measured twelve-yaw natural-source scout: 23 anchors, 12 plants, 60–120m. Flat procedural shading reduces strafe residual from .097031 to .028468; specular/fixed-LOD/fade do not solve it. Wind explains hold motion, not camera-motion instability.

Initial full per-triangle prototype passes near/reference equality and pixel hashes. Mean field luminance .4712477489 to .4712377005; stone strafe .012497 to .005045, flower .097045 to .004347. Superseded for cost.

Exact flower shading amplifier isolated: bounding edge alone changes species-isolated strafe .096622 to .027319; bounding canopy/removing ribs has no material effect. Full coverage .002754. Per-triangle candidate rejected for GPU tails +.491/.461/.380ms in quiet groups.

Four flower groups (8 triangles) plus exact-area stones pass near/reference/source/population gates. Raw stone strafe/approach .002893/.007173 versus .012497/.023216; flowers .005123/.007616 versus .097045/.095538. Mean field .4710791427, -0.0358%. Quiet groups 1/2/3 GPU medians +.0485/.27125/.4125ms and p95 +.0995/.2545/.351ms: strict .3ms target not uniformly met.

Rejected as a demonstrated cost optimization: 33540-byte stone area lookup has .47212% maximum relative error across 8192 mid-cell direction tests and matching visual improvement, but quiet GPU p95 +.138/.4535/.3495ms still misses target. Extra lookup is not selected for runtime.

Six quiet split-cost ABBA groups passed. Stone-only median +.449/.33225/.2665ms, p95 +.2435/.537/.342ms; flower-only median +.0845/.2565/-.12275ms, p95 +.270/.1705/-.042ms. No overlapping engine job observed. Supports prioritizing stone shader cost, not assuming flower triangle count remains the bottleneck.

Rejected integration preflight; owned engine stopped before motion/cost completion. Production geometry and flower shader equality passed; stone textual shader equality failed because comment normalization handled LF but not CRLF. Concurrent own line-ending cleanup also invalidated frozen-file qualification. Retained failure; no passing claim. Corrected line-ending comparison and reran the complete integration gate.

Early exit for fully faded stones retains visual residuals exactly at reported precision, all nearby/reference/source/population checks and pixel hashes pass. Three quiet groups: GPU median -.068/+.070/+.2025ms and p95 +.020/+.116/+.3015ms versus grass/fern baseline. Worst tail narrowly misses .3ms target; not silently rounded into a pass. Selected for source integration and fresh validation, no human approval.
